A '''ship''' was a [[Starship|ship]] designed to be used by the [[Raxus guard]]s. Used for transportation, it was also armed with [[laser cannon]]s on the bow of the ship.<ref name="Choices" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Raxus ship first appeared in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi]]'' episode titled "[[Choices]]."<ref name="Choices" />
